ItemID: 1; Title: iGaging Electronic Digital Caliper 0-8" IP54 Protection Large Display Inch/Metric/Fractions Stainless Steel Body; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Useful for checking component and mounting dimensions in my small electronics projects.
ItemID: 2; Title: 5 Pcs Dual Row 5 Position Screw Terminal Strip 600V 15A; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: A practical match for connecting wires in projects using relays and prototype boards.
ItemID: 3; Title: HATCHBOX 1.75mm Orange PLA 3D Printer Filament, 1 KG Spool, Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03 mm, 3D Printing Filament; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current printing project that calls for this filament.
ItemID: 4; Title: HATCHBOX ABS 3D Printer Filament, Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03 mm, 1 kg Spool, 1.75 mm, Gray; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent electronics work does not give me a specific need for ABS filament.
ItemID: 5; Title: AIRSUNNY three Legs 5 pairs Infrared Diode LED IR Emission and Receiver; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These look useful for experimenting with sensing circuits on my breadboards.
ItemID: 6; Title: NEIKO 50432A Hex Nut Assortment Set | 150 Pc Nylon Locking Nuts | A3 Steel Hex Assorted Hardware Kit #10 & SAE | Metal Screw Nut for Bolts | Friction Lock Nut; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would need to know the required bolt sizes before buying a hardware assortment.

ItemID: 8; Title: Drill America - DWTPT1INCH 1"-11-1/2 NPT Pipe Tap, Carbon Steel, DWTPT Series; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current pipe-threading task that needs this specialized tool.
ItemID: 9; Title: Super Lube 51004 Synthetic Oil with PTFE, High Viscosity, 4 oz Bottle,Translucent white(Packaging may vary); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The caster purchase alone does not give me a current need for lubricating oil.
